summary.text: Betsy Fogle is a Democratic state representative from Missouri House District 135, which she has represented since January 2021, and is the Democratic candidate for Missouri Senate District 30 in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Betsy Fogle was born in Springfield, Missouri, and graduated from Parkview High School.
She earned a bachelor's degree from Missouri State University and a master's degree in sociology from the University of Arkansas.
Her career experience includes work as director of program advancement for Jordan Valley Community Health Center.
Fogle is not running for re-election to House District 135 in 2026.
In the 2025-2026 session, she was assigned to the Budget Committee, the Fiscal Review Committee and the Joint Committee on Public Assistance.
